title: Sled acceleration from a cubic velocity
change: New context and a cubic velocity with a different time; same dv/dt power-rule skill as the seed.

title: Cart acceleration from a quadratic velocity
change: Polynomial with constant, linear and quadratic terms and a negative result; same dv/dt skill as the seed.

title: Probe acceleration with symbolic constants
change: Symbolic constants and two terms; same dv/dt power-rule skill as the seed.

title: Skater displacement from linear speed
change: Linear speed in a skating context with numbers; same integrate-velocity skill as the seed.

title: Displacement over a later time interval
change: Nonzero lower limit and a quadratic velocity; same integrate-velocity skill as the seed.

title: Distance traveled until the puck stops
change: Needs the stopping time first, then a two-term integral; same integrate-velocity skill as the seed.

title: Work by a force that grows with position
change: New numbers with units and a linear force; same W = ∫F dx skill as the seed.

title: Work by a quadratic force over a later interval
change: Quadratic force and a nonzero lower limit; same W = ∫F dx skill as the seed.

title: Net work when the force changes sign
change: Force that changes sign over the interval, so signed area matters; same W = ∫F dx skill as the seed (somewhat more demanding).

title: Force on a bead from a quadratic potential energy
change: Quadratic U with a different coefficient and numeric evaluation; same F = -dU/dx skill as the seed.

title: Force from a quartic potential energy
change: Quartic U with a linear term and a sign-only distractor; same F = −dU/dx skill as the seed.

title: Force from an inverse-distance potential energy
change: Inverse-distance potential with direction in the answer; same F = −dU/dx skill as the seed (derivative of a power with a negative exponent).

title: Energy delivered by a winch
change: Linear power function in a new context; same E = ∫P dt skill as the seed.

title: Energy from a motor over a later interval
change: Quadratic power with a constant term and a nonzero lower limit; same E = ∫P dt skill as the seed.

title: Energy from a pulse of power
change: Symbolic polynomial pulse; same E = ∫P dt skill as the seed.

title: Marble in a bowl
change: Physical bowl context and conceptual wording; same stable-equilibrium-is-a-minimum-of-U concept as the seed.

title: Stable point of a cubic potential
change: Cubic potential requiring slope and curvature tests; same stable-equals-minimum concept as the seed.

title: Equilibria from a force function
change: Equilibrium type determined from a force function (sign of dF/dx); same stable-equals-minimum-of-U concept as the seed, with one extra step.

title: Velocity from a cubic position function
change: New polynomial and numeric evaluation at a given time; same velocity-as-derivative idea as the seed.

title: Velocity from a quartic with a quadratic term
change: Symbolic velocity from a two-term polynomial in new letters; same differentiation skill as the seed.

title: When a particle is momentarily at rest
change: Uses the velocity derivative to find a rest time instead of evaluating it; same differentiation skill, harder setup.

title: Acceleration of a cubic position
change: Cubic position with numeric evaluation; same second-derivative idea as the seed's quartic.

title: Acceleration of a fifth-power position with a linear term
change: Symbolic acceleration from a two-term polynomial with a leftover linear term; same second-derivative skill as the seed.

title: Acceleration of an exponentially decaying position
change: Exponential position instead of a power; same second-derivative skill. Contains the only sign-only distractor for this seed.

title: Displacement of a cart that reverses
change: Piecewise velocity with a reversal; signed area gives displacement, same skill as the seed.

title: Displacement from a linear velocity function
change: Linear v(t) with a direction reversal, integrated over an interval; same displacement-from-velocity-area skill as the seed.

title: Displacement from an acceleration function and an initial velocity
change: Acceleration function plus initial velocity, integrated twice; the displacement is the area under the velocity graph, as in the seed.

title: Work by a force that grows as x squared
change: Power-law force F = 4x² with numeric limits; same work-as-integral idea as the seed's exponential force.

title: Work by a force that falls to zero at the end
change: Different variable force (polynomial that decreases to zero) with symbolic limits; same line-integral skill.

title: Work by an inverse-cube force over an infinite path
change: Inverse-power force with an infinite upper limit; convergent-integral work, same skill as the seed but a different function and answer.

title: Equilibrium at a potential-energy maximum
change: Inverted parabola instead of the seed's upward parabola; stability from local maximum versus minimum of U(x), same skill.

title: Locating a stable equilibrium from U(x)
change: Cubic U(x) with two equilibria; derivative test selects the stable one, same skill as the seed. Contains the only sign-only distractor for this seed.

title: Stability of an equilibrium in an inverse-power potential
change: Two-term inverse-power potential requiring both the equilibrium location and the curvature test; same stability criterion as the seed.

title: Time constant for a sliding block with drag
change: Numeric time constant for a block with F = −bv; same decay-time skill as the seed's symbolic form.

title: Speed of a decelerating cart at a later time
change: Evaluates the exponential speed at a given time instead of the symbolic time constant; same F = −bv dynamics.

title: Total distance traveled with linear drag
change: Integrates the exponential speed to a total stopping distance; same F = −bv model, harder multi-step reasoning than the seed (see report).

title: Car on a circular track
change: New context (car on a flat track) with numbers; same uniform-circular-motion acceleration idea; distractors are zero-acceleration, v/r and outward-direction errors.

title: Ball on a string, speed doubled
change: Conceptual proportional reasoning about a=v²/r and F=mv²/r with doubled speed; new context (ball on string).

title: Hammer-throw ball
change: Multi-step: v=2πr/T then F=mv²/r with new numbers; same uniform-circular-motion acceleration/net-force concept.

title: Work by a quadratic force
change: New force function and limits; same W = ∫F(x)dx idea; distractors mirror the seed's constant-force and endpoint-average errors plus a dropped lower limit.

title: Work by a force that reverses sign
change: Linear force that changes sign; signed-area integral; new numbers and function.

title: Work by an exponentially decaying force
change: Exponential force with chain-rule factor; same W = ∫F(x)dx idea; hardest of the three.

title: Force from a quartic potential
change: New potential (quartic) and symbolic constant; same F = −dU/dx; no sign-only distractor in this variant.

title: Force at a point from a cubic potential
change: Numeric evaluation of F = −dU/dx at a point; this is the one variant of the seed with a sign-only distractor.

title: Force from an inverse-square potential
change: Negative power of x, so exponent and sign handling are harder; same F = −dU/dx idea.

title: Block at the end of its oscillation
change: Spring-block turning point instead of a general potential; same K = 0, U = E idea.

title: Turning points in a parabolic well
change: Numeric turning points from U(x) = E for a new potential and energy.

title: Allowed region in a double-well potential
change: Non-monotonic potential: requires U <= E, barrier reasoning and the correct connected region; same turning-point idea.

title: Rope pulling a crate at an angle
change: Numeric P = Fv cos θ with an angle between F and v; new context.

title: Power from a work function
change: Calculus definition P = dW/dt of instantaneous power from a function; new context.

title: Power from a time-dependent force
change: Variable force: integrate a to get v, then P = F·v; distractors are constant-acceleration, F·a and average-power errors.
